<span class="ptitle">Program evaluation</span><br>
<span class="meta">PPHA 34600 / PPHA 34610 · Harris School of Public Policy · 2019–present</span>

## teaching resources

<div class="paper">
<span class="ptitle">Graduate econometrics notes</span><br>
<span class="meta">ARE 212 · UC Berkeley · Spring 2016</span>

Section notes, code, and exercises I wrote as the GSI for first-year PhD econometrics: R, matrix algebra and OLS, partitioned regression, hypothesis testing, GLS and MLE, asymptotics, robust and clustered standard errors, instrumental variables, power calculations, spatial data, and replication. They are retained here because they continue to be useful as econometrics references.
